feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 16 November 2026 5:30am
items.description:
##Today##

Clear spells with a slight frost in places and a small risk of icy patches at first. Dry with sunny spells in the morning, turning cloudy through the afternoon, with rain arriving later in the evening, turning wintry on high ground. Fresh northwest winds become light and variable for a time during the day, before becoming easterly in the afternoon, then increasing strong to gale force later in evening. Top temperature of 8°C.


##Temperature##

##Rainfall (mm):##

0-3


##Wind Speed##

##Wind Direction##

NW


##Wind##

Northwest 15-20, decreasing west 5-10 by midday, then sharply becoming east or southeast in the afternoon. Gradually increasing to 25-35, with gusts of 45, later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.


##Comments##

Risk of ice for a time. Strong winds and gales later.


##Tomorrow##

Rain through the night into Tuesday, turning heavy at times, and initially wintry on higher ground before temperatures rise. Minimum temperature 1°C . Rain persisting for much of the day, turning heavy at times, before clearing later. Strong to gale force east winds gradually easing. Top temperature 10°C.
